findings.title: Out-of-range mtime raises ValueError/OverflowError outside the try in _modified_at, making list/search return 500
findings.evidence: src/api/routes/workbench.py:275-280 (datetime.fromtimestamp at line 279 is outside the try/except OSError); datetime.fromtimestamp(2**40, tz=UTC) raises ValueError, 1e300 raises OverflowError; tmpfs accepts os.utime 2**40
findings.consequence: One file with an mtime outside years 1-9999 breaks GET /workbench/list for its directory and GET /workbench/search for every ancestor, including the repo root. Availability regression needing write access to the tree; no disclosure
findings.minimal_fix: Move the fromtimestamp/isoformat lines inside the try and catch (OSError, OverflowError, ValueError), returning None; add a test patching Path.stat to return st_mtime=2**40

findings.title: modified_at follows symlinks and reports the mtime of a target outside the repository (extends pre-existing symlink following)
findings.evidence: src/api/routes/workbench.py:276 uses path.stat(); probe: docs/zz-link.html -> /etc/hostname listed with modified_at of the external file; is_dir/is_file at :287 and :470 already followed symlinks (pre-existing)
findings.consequence: One more attribute of an out-of-repo file visible on a loopback, flag-gated route; requires a non-ignored symlink already placed in the repo
findings.minimal_fix: Use path.lstat() for modified_at, or return None when the entry is a symlink whose resolved target is outside REPO_ROOT

findings.title: Viewer issues a full one-directory listing (git check-ignore over all siblings) on every select, tab switch and Refresh (subprocess-per-listing cost is pre-existing)
findings.evidence: ts/src/stage/HtmlViewerRegion.tsx:374-380 and :421-434; src/api/routes/workbench.py:445-449 and :245-249 apply q after the ignore check
findings.consequence: Repeated git subprocesses on a loopback single-user server for very large directories; bounded by user clicks
findings.minimal_fix: None required; optionally filter by q/ext before calling _git_ignored_paths in /list
